name: Autoresearch-pack loop failed — chain pause marker
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack failure handler. Fires when an autoresearch-pack role (EXCEPT autoresearch-execute) terminates with outcome=failed BEFORE emitting its decide() terminal — model timeout, NATS blip, OOM, panic, max_iterations hit without terminal decide. Without this rule, the failure stalls the chain silently. Stamps a chain.paused.marker triple so operator dashboards (and mock-LLM journey assertions) can surface the pause.

autoresearch-execute is INTENTIONALLY excluded from the role list — per the reviewer C1 fix (2026-05-29), execute loop-failures route through rule 04b (which stamps experiment.completed + experiment.loop_failed) so they count toward the cap budget rather than pausing the chain. A loop-failed execute is a budgeted-but-evidence-empty iteration; the chain continues to the next propose. Loop-failed baseline / propose / synthesize / reviewer DO need operator intervention (no way to recover without intervention), so they still pause here.

metadata.mirrors_research_pattern: Same shape as configs/rules/research/08-loop-failed-pause.json, scoped to autoresearch role tokens. Marker-only triple (chain.paused.marker with timestamp object); full §D5 audit triples were retired in MVP-7 per the research pack's pattern.
metadata.long_chain_caveat: An autoresearch chain at cap=10 has at minimum 22 loops (1 baseline + 10 × (propose + execute) + 1 synthesize + 1 reviewer + 1 coordinator wake-up). The chainstall subscriber was tuned for short chains; under chainstall classification a long autoresearch chain that hits multiple reverted outcomes may be misclassified as 'stalling'. The chain.paused.marker stamp is the lowest-common-denominator failure surface that works regardless of stall classification. Real-LLM smoke validation will surface whether the chainstall machinery needs autoresearch-aware tuning (pack README §Open substrate questions #4).
